newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy sets trial of Diablo radio link.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy sets trial of Diablo radio link.

text.p: Diablo Research Corp said Monday it has begun shipping Whisper radio components for a field trial to be conducted in Scottsbluff, Nebraska by KN Energy Inc.

The trial, designed to do automatic meter reading of natural gas meters and remote sensing of other devices, will use Metricom Inc's wireless Ricochet network as the wide area network for delivering data to KN's billing center.
It is expected the trial will demonstrate billing efficiencies beneficial to the utility while providing Internet access to rural customers.

Development work on the Whisper radio technology was partially funded by the Gas Research Institute of Chicago. Diablo Research engineers surveyed dozens of utility companies across the US and realized that there wasn't an automatic meter reading radio technology on the market that met these utilities' communication requirements for the future.
